archetype: ARCHETYPE 1: ORGANIC & EARTHY (Trust, Growth, Calm) blended with Precision Edge IoT

typography.pairing_rules: Outfit (bold, friendly, modern tech headings) + DM Sans (grounded, natural, high-legibility body) + JetBrains Mono (precision telemetry, timestamps, confidence scores, hardware specs)

entry_surfaces./: split hero — earthy dark green gradient hero with headline, live status badge & dual CTA left, interactive hardware-to-cloud live preview card right
entry_surfaces./dashboard: precision telemetry grid — live stats bar top, filter pills and simulated detection demo CTA, followed by side-by-side snapshot vs Flickr reference gallery

motion.default_transition: transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease, border-color 0.2s ease

accessibility.contrast_standard: APCA & WCAG AA minimum 4.5:1 text-to-surface contrast
accessibility.data_testids: All interactive elements, buttons, tabs, filter pills, stat numbers, detection cards have explicit data-testid attributes.

feature_wildlife.description: Wild majestic deer near forest fringe

feature_cattle.description: Cattle and livestock roaming farm pasture

component_structure.navbar: Sticky crystal/solid header with brand logo (Animal Guard + shield/camera icon), nav links (Home, How It Works, Features, Architecture, Live Dashboard), and primary CTA 'Open Dashboard'
component_structure.landing_hero: Split layout: Left column with headline, badge, mission statement, primary & secondary CTAs. Right column with interactive simulated camera viewfinder showcasing real-time bounding box and live telemetry
component_structure.how_it_works: 4-step interactive pipeline cards: 1. Raspberry Pi Camera Watch → 2. YOLOv8 Edge Inference → 3. Flickr Reference Photo Verification → 4. Multi-Channel Alert Dispatch (Email, SMS, WhatsApp)
component_structure.features_grid: 6 visual feature tiles with custom badge indicators, icons, technical details (YOLOv8 nano models, Twilio integration, low-cost RPi compute)
component_structure.architecture_flow: Visual pipeline diagram card connecting Raspberry Pi 4/5 Camera Node → FastAPI Cloud Backend → Flickr API & Twilio Alert Gateway → Real-time React Dashboard
component_structure.dashboard_stats_bar: 4 high-impact counters: Total Detections, Wild Animals, Cattle & Livestock, Domestic Animals with delta indicators
component_structure.dashboard_controls: Category filter tabs (All, Wild, Cattle, Domestic), search/filter input, 'Simulate Detection' demo action button, live 10s auto-refresh indicator with pause/resume toggle
component_structure.detection_card: Split card showcasing: Camera Snapshot (with YOLOv8 bounding box overlay preview) vs Flickr Species Reference Photo side-by-side, Species name, Category badge, Confidence score bar, Timestamp (ISO UTC formatted to local), and link to external Flickr photos
component_structure.footer: Deep forest surface with docs, setup guide, GitHub repo download links, Twilio/Flickr API acknowledgments, and system status badge

instructions_to_main_agent: Template is farm-ts (FastAPI backend at /app/backend, React 19 frontend at /app/frontend).
Use Tailwind v4 CSS variables in /app/frontend/src/index.css with font imports '@fontsource-variable/outfit' and '@fontsource-variable/dm-sans' and '@fontsource-variable/jetbrains-mono'.
Ensure both routes exist in App.tsx: '/' for Landing Page and '/dashboard' for Live Dashboard.
Implement backend endpoints: GET /api/stats, GET /api/detections?category=&limit=50, and POST /api/detections/simulate (for testing and manual trigger).
Seed rich sample detection records in backend (deer, wild boar, bear, elephant, cow, horse, sheep, dog, cat) with camera snapshot URLs, Flickr reference photos, confidence scores, and timestamps.
Support 10-second polling on /dashboard via TanStack React Query (refetchInterval: 10000).
Provide clear empty state when no detections match a filter.
Include data-testid on every button, link, filter pill, stat card, detection card, and input.
Follow the warm earthy palette: Cream background (#FBF9F4), Deep forest green (#142B1B, #2D6A4F), Warm amber/terracotta accent (#C85A17), and crisp card panels (#FFFFFF).
